bio.text: Laura Friedman has represented California's 30th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 2025; the district includes Burbank, Glendale, West Hollywood and parts of Los Angeles and Pasadena.
Before Congress she represented the 44th District in the California State Assembly, and she served on the Glendale City Council and as Mayor of Glendale.
She was born in New York, lives in Glendale, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Rochester in 1988.
Before public office she worked as a film and television producer.
She is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
